# TransGlobal Food Tech

> TransGlobal Food Tech (Transglobal Foodtech LLP) is a food, nutrition and wellness company based in Mumbai, India. It works directly with farmers to source natural ingredients and builds better everyday products for families.

## Who we are

- Legal name: Transglobal Foodtech LLP
- Founded by Visha Michelle Iyer (Co-Founder) and Aditya Mahimkar (Co-Founder)
- Address: 401, Jyoti Building, 15th Road, Santacruz (West), Mumbai 400054, India
- Email: vmi@transglobalfoodtech.com
- Phone: +91 99204 44200
- Website: https://www.transglobalfoodtech.com/

## What we do

- Work directly with farmers and source their produce, to reduce agricultural wastage and connect local farms to national and international markets
- Develop products across the food and wellness value chain: fresh and natural ingredients, fruits and vegetables, spices and botanicals, food and beverages, freeze-dried foods, nutraceuticals and functional nutrition, wellness products and natural cosmetics
- Operate as a multi-brand platform, building new brands across food, nutrition, wellness and natural products

## Our brands

- [OSOEAZY](https://www.osoeazy.com): our first consumer brand, bringing together food, beverages, functional nutrition, nutraceuticals, wellness and everyday products. Tagline: "Beauty & Health From Within."

## Contact

Business, partnership, distribution, sourcing and career enquiries: use the form at https://www.transglobalfoodtech.com/#contact or email vmi@transglobalfoodtech.com.
